# 4RinLabs

> 4RinLabs is a creative digital studio and software company specializing in AI development, SaaS platforms, web applications, mobile apps, and custom software solutions for startups and enterprises worldwide.

## Company

- **Name:** 4RinLabs
- **Website:** [https://www.4rinlabs.com](https://www.4rinlabs.com)
- **Email:** [4rinlabs@gmail.com](mailto:4rinlabs@gmail.com)
- **Type:** Software Development Company / Creative Digital Studio

## Services

- [AI Development](https://www.4rinlabs.com/services/ai-development): Custom AI solutions built for production, LLM integrations (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini), RAG systems, autonomous agents, and workflow automation.
- [Custom Software Development](https://www.4rinlabs.com/services/custom-software-development): Bespoke internal tools, dashboards, enterprise systems, and API development engineered around client workflows.
- [SaaS Development](https://www.4rinlabs.com/services/saas-development): End-to-end multi-tenant SaaS platforms with subscription billing, user authentication, and analytics dashboards.
- [Web Development](https://www.4rinlabs.com/services/web-development): Modern web applications, marketing pages, and e-commerce built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
- [Mobile App Development](https://www.4rinlabs.com/services/mobile-app-development): Cross-platform iOS and Android application development using React Native.
- [WhatsApp CRM](https://www.4rinlabs.com/services/whatsapp-crm): WhatsApp Business API solutions, automated lead qualification, broadcasts, and CRM integrations.
- [Digital Marketing](https://www.4rinlabs.com/services/digital-marketing): Performance-driven marketing, paid ads (Meta and Google), content strategy, and SEO.

## Technology Stack

- **Frontend:** Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- **Backend:** Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM
- **AI/ML:** OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, LangChain, vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone)
- **Mobile:** React Native (iOS & Android)
- **Cloud & DevOps:** Vercel, AWS, GCP
- **Authentication:** Auth.js (NextAuth)

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is 4RinLabs?**
4RinLabs is a creative digital studio that builds AI solutions, SaaS platforms, web applications, and custom software for startups and enterprises worldwide.

**What AI services does 4RinLabs offer?**
We build custom AI systems including LLM integrations, RAG pipelines, AI agents, multi-agent architectures, chatbots, computer vision systems, and workflow automation.

**How long does a project take?**
A focused marketing site may ship in 2-4 weeks. Larger products and AI systems typically run 6-12 weeks with clear milestones.

**Do you work with startups?**
Yes. We work with startups from MVP validation through scale, as well as established enterprises needing custom software or AI capabilities.
